# Tabler Core

Version: 1.5.0 (pinned npm package `@tabler/core`). MIT licensed.

`controls.css` is generated from official `dist/css/tabler.css` by
`scripts/build-design-system.mjs`. Component declarations are retained verbatim;
global reboot and page scaffolding are excluded. No Tabler JavaScript is loaded.
